core_obligations: The set of closed domains: the proof introduces the family of closed domains of the target, that is, subsets equal to the closure of their interior, and notes that the closure of any open subset is a closed domain (proof lines 5331-5334).

Mapping points to closed domains: each point of the target is assigned the closed domain determined by the family of open neighbourhoods of the points of the image that contain it, which is a map from the target into the power set of the set of closed domains (proof lines 5334-5341).

Injectivity: two distinct points are separated by an open set, and by Hausdorffness the corresponding closed domains differ; this is the step where the Hausdorff hypothesis is used (proof lines 5341-5344).
Counting: the target injects into the double power set of the set of closed domains, which has cardinality at most that of the double power set of the source, as claimed (proof line 5344).
proof_roadmap: 先引入闭域（等于自身内部闭包的集合）的族；任一开集的闭包都是闭域。
把 Y 的每点映到由“含它的像的开邻域”决定的闭域，得到 Y 到闭域集之幂集的单射；Hausdorff 性给出单射性。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the cardinality bound for a Hausdorff space that is the closure of the image of a continuous map (author lemma at source lines 5322-5328, label lemma-dense-image): the target has cardinality at most that of the double power set of the source. The proof (source lines 5330-5345) is a real argument rather than a citation: it introduces the closed domains of the target, assigns to each point the closed domain cut out by the open neighbourhoods of the image containing it, and shows this assignment is injective using Hausdorffness to separate points (proof lines 5334-5344). The lemma is the cardinality input for the construction of the Stone-Cech compactification in this section. H2.
